# Kit Adda — Official Football Jersey Store India

> Kit Adda (@kit.adda) is India's dedicated football streetwear and jersey platform, specializing in Master Grade player versions, fan version kits, retro classic drops, and performance anti-slip grip socks.

## Store Overview
- Website: https://kitadda.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/kit.adda
- WhatsApp Direct Support: +91 93159 63809 (https://wa.me/919315963809)
- Email: kitadda01@gmail.com
- Operating Geography: Pan-India Express Delivery

## Collections & Product Categories
- **Player Version Kits**: Authentic athletic slim fit, breathable aeroready/dri-fit moisture-wicking weave, heat-applied crests.
- **Fan Version Kits**: Regular stadium comfort fit with high-density embroidered crests.
- **Retro Vault**: Iconic throwback and collector jerseys from legendary seasons.
- **World Cup & International**: Official national team home, away, and tournament editions.
- **Grip Socks & Accessories**: Pro-grade anti-slip silicone lock-in grip socks for football matches.

## Shipping, Payment & Delivery Details
- **Payment Method**: 100% Secure Prepaid Checkout (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Cards, Net Banking) powered by Razorpay.
- **Delivery Timelines**:
  - Delhi NCR: 2 – 3 Business Days
  - Rest of India: 3 – 6 Business Days
- **Free Shipping**: Available automatically on all orders of ₹1499 and above (Standard flat fee of ₹99 for orders below ₹1499).
- **Tracking**: Real-time live tracking links with AWB numbers are dispatched automatically via WhatsApp and SMS upon courier pickup.

## Replacement & Exchange Policy
- **Inspection Guarantee**: Instant replacement provided in case of transit damage or wrong item delivered.
- **Requirement**: A continuous, uncut parcel unboxing video starting from the sealed courier package is strictly mandatory for any claims.
- **Contact Window**: Within 48 hours of parcel delivery via WhatsApp at +91 93159 63809.
